name: SRU Steels Limited
about: SRU Steels Limited engages in trading of stainless steel, construction machinery, footwear, and agriculture commodities in India. The company sources and supplies TMT bars, steel billets, wire rods, structural steel, and agri-grade steel products to builders, contractors, agricultural businesses, and re-rolling mills. It also engages in the sale of products on a commission basis; and manufacturing, processing, trading, importing, exporting, and dealing in textiles, metals, machinery, agricultural produce, consumer and industrial products, and allied goods. The company was formerly known as SRU Knitters Limited and changed its name to SRU Steels Limited in April 2010. SRU Steels Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
